text: This report provides a summary of the activities performed in 2018 by Toronto Water's Environmental Monitoring and Protection Unit ("EM&P"), which is responsible for administrative compliance and enforcement of the City of Toronto's Municipal Code Chapter 681 ("Sewers By-Law") and Municipal Code Chapter 851 ("Water Supply By-Law). It also provides a report back, as requested by City Council, on the outcome of the Lavender Creek Water Quality Assessment undertaken by Toronto Water's EM&P. In 2018, EM&P performed 3,256 tasks, such as company inspections, dye tests, meetings with businesses, storm sewer outfall inspections under the Sewers By-law and 857 inspections under the Water Supply By-law.
